config.pad_handling: use true (non-PAD) sequence lengths to pack sequences before the GRU so PAD steps are never processed as real input, and to correctly extract the final forward and final backward hidden states at each sequence's true last non-PAD position. Samples with zero non-PAD length are never passed into pack_padded_sequence (which requires length >= 1) -- they are excluded from the GRU call entirely and assigned a finite zero hidden representation directly
config.dropout_placement: num_layers=1, so nn.GRU's constructor dropout argument is set to 0 (it would otherwise silently no-op between layers anyway). The configured dropout=0.3 is applied as its own explicit nn.Dropout layer on the final concatenated forward+backward hidden vector, before the linear classifier head
